speaker: Dash
intro: Dash Delgado, Speedy Slice Pizza! Thirty minutes or it's free. So, um, can we do this in twenty?
Day 8, trainee: the Case Files. A young man in a very big hurry...
I woke up yesterday and my right ear was just... gone. Probably wax. Can you be quick?
Gone overnight? Hold on to your pizza. This could matter a lot.

always_clues.text: Right ear went overnight, yesterday morning

options: Exactly when did it start?
Yesterday, when I woke up. There was a pop, then whooshing. About thirty hours ago?
Pop, then whooshing: about 30 hours ago
onset
Thirty hours. Every one of them counts. Keep going!
What's the best pizza topping?
Pineapple. Fight me. Actually, don't, I'm busy.
Has your hearing ever done this before?
Never. The right was perfect until yesterday. I hear my scooter fine with the left.
Never before: right ear fine until yesterday
first_time
Any pain, drainage, or dizziness?
No pain, no drips. A bit wobbly yesterday, fine now. Just the whoosh.
No pain or drainage; a bit wobbly yesterday
red_flag_check
Have you tried cleaning it out?
I tried a cotton bud. Nothing came out. Pretty sure it's wax though.
Tried a cotton bud: nothing came out
cotton_bud
Never poke in there! And 'probably wax' is a guess. We'll look.
Can I get a free pizza?
If I'm late, EVERYBODY gets a free pizza. Which is why we must HURRY.

joke_line: Tasty, but not a clue, and the clock is ticking. Ask about his ear!

red_flags.ask_line: Always ask about red flags: pain, drainage, dizziness.
red_flags.answer: No pain, no drips. A bit wobbly yesterday, fine now. Just the whoosh.
red_flags.clue: No pain or drainage; a bit wobbly yesterday
red_flags.card:
Sudden, one ear, yesterday: YES.
That red flag can't wait.

after_history: A sudden loss in one ear, yesterday. Every hour counts, so: quick AND careful.

otoscopy.caption: Dash's RIGHT ear: clear canal. No wax at all!
lines: Clear canal, healthy eardrum. Not a speck of wax!
No wax? Then what's blocking it?
Maybe nothing is blocking it. Let's check the middle ear next.

tymp.clue: Tymp: type A both ears (no fluid, no blockage)
after: Type A both sides: no fluid, no blockage. Something deeper changed.

instructions: Tell him: press for every beep, even faint ones. No racing the beeps!
Beeps only. Fast but accurate. Like my deliveries!

audiometry.intro: Better ear first, like the pros. Left at Hoot speed!
Right ear's yours. Start at 1k, as always.
Bone check at Hoot speed: is it the inner ear?
before: Wax would block air but not bone. The bone buzzer will tell us!

after_audiometry: Masked bone sits right with the air. No gap: not wax, not fluid.

reveal.title: ONE EAR, OVERNIGHT
lines: Right ear down 50 to 65 dB, left ear normal. One ear, overnight.
Not wax, not fluid. And that's exactly what makes it urgent.

evidence.prompt: What type of loss is Dash's right ear?
options: Sensorineural: bone is down with the air.
Conductive: blocked, like wax.
Mixed: a bit of both.
wrong: Then bone would be near normal. His masked bone is down with the air.
Mixed needs a gap too. His bone and air sit together.
evidence.right: Sensorineural and sudden: the inner ear changed overnight.

findings.text: Right ear down, bone too: inner ear

lines.today: Sudden sensorineural loss is urgent. Treatment works best early. Doctor TODAY!
lines.fit: A hearing aid on a brand-new sudden loss? Doctor first, and today: treatment works best early.
lines.refer: A routine referral could take weeks. Sudden hearing loss can't wait: TODAY.

clue_pick.prompt: Present the evidence: why TODAY and not next month?
clue_pick.wrong_line: True, but that wouldn't make it a rush. What makes it urgent?
clue_pick.right_line: Exactly! Sudden, one ear, inner ear: the doctor sees him today.

payoff: Hoot here, Booth Camp. Sudden loss in the right ear, since yesterday. Can you see him today?
Dash, the ear doctor sees you at three. Go straight there, pizzas or not.
Same day? Faster than my pizzas! Thanks, owl!

headlines.S: SUDDEN LOSS SPOTTED IN RECORD TIME; PIZZA STILL HOT
headlines.A: COURIER RUSHED TO EAR DOCTOR SAME DAY; TOPPINGS DEBATE CONTINUES
headlines.B: DASH SENT TO DOCTOR TODAY; OWL CHECKS WATCH
headlines.C: SOME BEEPS ARRIVED COLD, CONFIRMS OWL
headlines.Do-over: TRAINEE DEMANDS REMATCH; DASH ALREADY AT THE DOCTOR

subheads.S: One ear, overnight, inner ear: a same-day referral. Every hour counted.
subheads.A: A sudden one-sided loss can't wait: doctor today.
subheads.B: The call was right; a few stamps wandered.
subheads.C: Sudden plus sensorineural means doctor today.
subheads.Do-over: Remember: sudden hearing loss is urgent. Dash made his appointment anyway.
